# B02 — Repair the existing workshop

[START](../../guide/00-START.md). Depends: B01. Outcome: existing scheduling does not lie or forget on restart.

Read `server/tasks/executor.ts`, `server/loops/manager.ts`, `server/autonomic/loop.ts`, `server/actions/pipeline.ts`, `server/app.ts`; load only functions for the active slice. Existing tests: `tests/p14/`, `tests/p15/`, `tests/autonomic/`. New tests belong beside the behavior.

## Slices

- **s1:** Reproduce success=true/verified=false and cancellation-versus-completion. Require verified postconditions for task completion; use conditional state transitions so cancellation cannot be overwritten.
- **s2:** Persist/reconstruct schedule state and occurrences. Replace JS-function trigger persistence with validated declarative trigger data and an explicit evaluator registry. Test fresh-process restart, repeat schedule and duplicate occurrence.
- **s3:** Recover expired running task attempts through reconciliation. Preserve receipts; never blindly rerun unknown external writes. Test crash before/after effect with a temporary file DB.
- **s4:** Separate reminder persistence, dispatch and receipt. Non-null cycle alone is not delivery. Make local state/event changes transactional where possible; test event-publication failure and recovery.

Add numbered migrations only after inspecting the latest migration list; never rewrite applied SQL. Each slice must first exhibit the defect. Do not bundle all four into one small-model prompt.

## Gate

Targeted tests plus existing scheduling/autonomic suites pass. No duplicated occurrence, false completion, cancelled overwrite or lost restored trigger in the test matrix. Preserve baseline unrelated failures explicitly.

Next: B03/s1. No new UI or model replacement here.
